rankings.summaryHtml: During its 10-game win streak that included six wins on the road, OKC shot .525 as a team, averaged 110.2 points and won by an average margin of 12.1 PPG. rankings.summaryHtml: For just the second time in its NBA history, Indiana has posted double-digit win totals through the first three months of the season: 13-1 in November, 10-4 in December, 10-5 in January. So three All-Stars sounds about right; yes, we do count Frank Vogel joining Paul George and Roy Hibbert.

rankings.summaryHtml: Nothing quite matches the 16-0 December that L.A. rung up last season. But its 12-4 mark in January, with Chris Paul's bad shoulder allowing him to play in only two of the games, is tied for the second-winningest month in team history.  And now CP3 is poised to return to work this week.

rankings.summaryHtml: The stat that made the rounds on Super Bowl Sunday, courtesy of @nbastats, has the Grizzlies sporting the league's best record (and fourth-best defense) since Dec. 21.
